# Coaching methodology parameters (this server)

Versioned numbers the coach reasons over. Not prose advice. Per-athlete overrides (limiter, stated hours, event demands) live in a goals store if connected — never CTL, race dates, athlete ids, or Intervals API keys.

After `icu_get_athlete_state`, read this resource before drafting a season or week. Writes stay propose-then-approve.

## Phase from nearest RACE_A (ATP optional)

If Annual Training Plan PLAN blocks cover today, use those (`source: atp`). Else derive from days_out to the nearest RACE_A (`source: derived_from_race`). Missing ATP is not a gap. No RACE_A and no ATP → `source: unspecified`: search this calendar (365d), then goals MCP / Drive / GCal / chat, then ask. Do not invent a year-out plan without an Intervals A-date.

```
recovery_post_a: days after A-race <= 14
taper:  days_out <= 14
peak:   days_out <= 28
build:  days_out <= 84
base:   days_out >= 85
```

## Intensity distribution (by observed weekly hours)

```
8h and over:        polarized
6h to under 8h:     pyramidal
under 6h:           threshold
```

Polarized: z1 0.75 / z2 0.08 / z3 0.17.
Pyramidal: z1 0.80 / z2 0.12 / z3 0.08.
Threshold: z1 0.67 / z2 0.25 / z3 0.08.

Polarized from 8h assumes a competitive athlete; for a recreational one, pyramidal gave more VO2max (Rosenblat 2025), so offer it as the alternative.
Anti-pattern: living in the middle (endurance rides creeping into tempo).

## Taper (A-race)

Duration 8–14 days optimal (max 21). Cut volume exponentially 41–60% (cluster ~50%). Hold intensity. Cut frequency at most ~20%.

## Ramp

CTL/week: conservative 3 / standard 5 / aggressive 7. Pick from `fitness_form.tsb_tolerance`, not a fixed ceiling. Max 3 consecutive build weeks; recovery week ~60% load.

Tier rule (first match): aggressive = 2+ excursions below -25 TSB with median recovery <= 10 days; conservative = median recovery > 14 days; standard = min observed TSB <= -15; else conservative. Red readiness drops one tier.

Weekly load for a CTL gain of r: 7 x (CTL + 6.51 x r). Peak holds CTL (r = 0). Taper week load vs the pre-taper reference: 65% at 8-14 days out, 45% in race week. Post-A recovery: <= 50%, no intensity. A recovery week is one at or under 75% of the mean of the three weeks before it.

`icu_get_athlete_state` already applies these rules in `analysis.coach_brief`. Use those numbers; do not re-derive different ones.

## Session menu (pick by phase; durations scale with available hours)

```
base:    long Z2 ride (the week's anchor), tempo / sweet spot 2-3 x 15-20m
         at 84-92% FTP, one neuromuscular set (6-8 x 10s sprints), strength x2
build:   threshold 2 x 20m or 3 x 15m at 95-100% FTP; VO2 5 x 5m or 4 x 8m
         at 105-115% FTP (or 3 sets of 13 x 30s/15s); long ride with tempo late
peak:    race-specific: efforts at race power and duration, shorter recoveries,
         volume flat or slightly down
taper:   same intensities, half the reps, short openers 1-2 days out
recovery / general_fitness: Z1-Z2 only for recovery; for general fitness one
         threshold-type and one VO2-type session a week on a Z2 base
```

Rules: hard sessions at least 48h apart; never two hard days before the long ride; a group ride counts as the hard session it actually is; strength not the day before a key session; if `60m_to_ftp_gap` is flagged, bias toward longer threshold intervals over more VO2. B race: 2-3 easy days before, no full taper. C race: train through.

## FTP check

`analysis.ftp_check` is the only FTP verdict (keep / raise / lower). Do not estimate FTP yourself (no 20m x 0.95 in chat). Estimate = Intervals eFTP, else 20m best x 0.95 — unless 20m / 60m best > 1.15: then the 20m rule overstates this athlete and only eFTP counts. Change suggested only when the estimate is 5%+ from the setting. A 60m best below FTP is a durability limiter, not a reason to change FTP.

## Readiness gating (daily swap, not rewrite-the-week)

Hold weekly structure; swap session type. Threshold moves, it does not vanish. If a key session is deferred twice, surface the conflict — do not drop it.

```
unknown: today's HRV AND sleep both missing (RHR or CTL on a training day
         does not count). Do not treat as green. Do not run the amber/red
         swap. Wait for overnight sync or ask; log via icu_update_wellness.
green: hrv_z >= -0.5 AND rhr_z <= 1.0 AND sleep_debt_h < 2
       (only after at least one of HRV or sleep is present today)
amber: hrv_z in [-1.5, -0.5) OR rhr_z in (1.0, 2.0] OR sleep_debt_h >= 2
  → if today is high-intensity, swap with nearest endurance/recovery day
red:   hrv_z < -1.5 OR consecutive_days_below_baseline >= 3 OR rhr_z > 2.0
  → recovery/rest; 2 consecutive red: propose 20–30% week load cut (wait for yes)
  → 4 consecutive red: flag for human review
```

Subjective fields (mood, motivation, fatigue, soreness, stress) on Intervals wellness. Empty → lower-confidence state; prompt `icu_update_wellness`. There is no `wellbeing` field.

## Return from a break (illness, injury, unplanned time off)

Days missed = the SICK / INJURED window, start to end inclusive. Pre-break load = the last full week before it in `coach_brief.load.last_completed_weeks`. This overrides `load.next_week_target` until the rebuild is done; say so.

```
1-2 days:  resume the plan as written. Missed sessions are gone, not moved.
3-7 days:  first week back at 67% of pre-break load, first 2 days easy (Z1-Z2)
8+ days:   first week back at 50% of pre-break load, first 3 days easy
rebuild:   back to pre-break load in even steps over as many weeks as were
           missed (rounded up, at least 1), then the normal ramp resumes
```

No intensity until the easy days felt normal. One hard session in the first week back at most, shortened. Never make up missed key sessions. Illness: the first session back comes after a full symptom-free day; fever or chest symptoms mean rest, not easy riding. Above-the-neck symptoms only: easy movement at most (Z1, up to 45 minutes). Injury: pain-free sports first, the injured sport last and easy; pain that changes how they move stops the session.

These are coaching defaults, not a medical protocol. Fitness lost in 3-14 days off is small (VO2max about 7% down after three weeks: Coyle et al. 1984), so the cuts protect recovery from the illness or injury rather than make up lost fitness. Return-to-sport timelines after respiratory illness are not established (IOC consensus 2022). Anything beyond a mild illness, or symptoms that come back, is a question for a doctor.

## Mixed-sport load

Intervals combined TSS is the CTL the charts use. Do not invent sport-weighted load. Flag mixed-sport weeks in analysis.

## Where these numbers come from

basis: sourced = taken from the references; derived = computed from a sourced value or the load model; default = a coaching choice, bounded by the references. Say which when an athlete asks why.

```
PHASE_FROM_A_RACE: default [taper sourced] (Bosquet 2007)
READINESS_THRESHOLDS: default (Kiviniemi 2007, Vesterinen 2016, Javaloyes 2019, Plews 2013, Craven 2022)
TSB_EXCURSION_THRESHOLD: default
TSB_RECOVERED_THRESHOLD: default
DISTRIBUTION_MODELS: default [shares sourced] (Seiler 2010, Seiler & Kjerland 2006, Esteve-Lanao 2007, Neal 2013, Treff 2019, Rosenblat 2019, Rosenblat 2025)
TAPER: sourced (Bosquet 2007, Wang 2023)
RAMP: default (Nielsen 2014, Buist 2008, Frandsen 2025)
CTL_WEEK_GAIN_FACTOR: derived
RAMP_SELECTION: default
RECOVERY_WEEK_RATIO: default
TAPER_WEEK_LOAD_PCT: derived (Bosquet 2007)
POST_A_RECOVERY_LOAD_PCT: default (Martinez-Navarro 2021)
HARD_SESSION_INTENSITY_FACTOR: default
FTP_CHECK: default [twenty_min_factor sourced, change_pct derived] (Borszcz 2018, Borszcz 2019, Borszcz 2020, MacInnis 2019, Lillo-Bevia 2022, Allen & Coggan 2010)
RETURN_FROM_BREAK: default (Coyle 1984, Mujika & Padilla 2000, IOC 2022, Eichner neck check)
```
